visualCharacteristics.purpose: Wrapping 4/2/1 grid of document cards: bold title above a bordered cover thumbnail, red outline "Read" button
visualCharacteristics.description: Closest is Biomek cards-scroll (document covers linking to assets) but that is a single-row horizontal scroll strip with hover 'Download' overlays and no titles above the image; cards-product is bordered product cards with image first. This is a wrapping 4/row grid, title on top, cover image, visible outline 'Read' button: under 80% similar.

contentPattern.summary: 9 application-note cards in a wrapping 4-column grid: bold title, document cover thumbnail, red outline 'Read' button; each links to its application-note detail page
contentPattern.structure: one row per card: (1) cover image (optionally linked); (2) bold title paragraph + "Read" link

reuseGuidance: Use for application notes / resource listings. For a horizontal strip use cards-scroll.
